svg.aria-label: agent-hub: the orchestrator files a task, the hub runs it on cheap worker models through gates and review, one line comes back, the orchestrator decides
svg.title: agent-hub

g.text: files a task — and goes quiet
the hub hands it to cheap models
each works in its own worktree
results come back through the gates
a review panel in fresh sessions
Claude decides. Cheap models do the work.
